# Sprite art. A ":" line names a sprite, then its rows.
#
#   .       transparent - the background shows through
#   0 1 2 3 pen number
#
# Rows must all be the same length and a multiple of 4 pixels, because mode 1
# packs 4 pixels to a byte and sprites are blitted on byte boundaries.
#
# In-game palette follows loukoumas.md: 0 navy background, 1 coral (paws,
# nose, sausages), 2 butter yellow (fur), 3 white (eyes, belly, highlights).
# Pen 0 is used opaquely for the pupils, where it reads as dark against white.
#
# tools/mksprite.py turns this into src/sprites.asm.

:CAT_STAND

..2222............2222..

# Skoupo-Terminator 3000. Coral like the sausages, because the floor and the
# shelves are white and a white robot would vanish into them - so the shape has
# to do the work: sensor mast, eye panels, a wide dark grille and wheels.
:ROBOT
..........33............
..........33............
.........1111...........
...111111111111111111...

.1111111111111111111111.
.3331111111111111111333.
.333................333.

# Furniture used to live here as masked sprites. At the scale it actually
# wants to be - a sofa is two metres long, a fridge is taller than a person -
# that came to about 30 KB, which does not exist on this machine. Rooms build
# their furniture out of filled rectangles instead; see rooms.asm.
